source: 刘晓燕《四级你还在背单词吗》
title: The Table on the Plain
tts_text: The eating house stands alone on a wide, flat plain, two hours from the sea. Behind the counter hangs an old picture of Marta's mother, painted in 1978. The colours are still vivid, and the face seems to animate the whole room. Marta says the picture helped the family survive three hard winters. Every spring she tries to revive the recipes written in her mother's notebook. There is pork, beef and mutton in the cold room, and seafood on Fridays. She cuts the meat into thin slices and drops them into a hot sauce. On the side she puts a bowl of chips, an onion salad and a plate of snacks. Guests chew slowly, lick their fingers and wipe them with a paper napkin. They dine at the long wooden table, and in summer they eat out on a picnic by the lake. One July afternoon her grandson dived from a rock into the water. It was deep and cold, and for a second he was sure he would drown. He came up coughing, and rain began to pour on the picnic cloth. That year the price of meat plunged, but Marta still complained about the cost. What puzzled the family most was one page of the notebook. Nobody could guess what the last line meant. Then a young cook from the city made a radical change: he cooked the dish for eight hours. Now guests of every racial background drive out from the city for it.

sentences_cn: 这家小饭馆孤零零地立在平坦的大平原上，离海两小时车程。
柜台后面的墙上挂着一张玛尔塔母亲的老照片，是 1978 年画的。
颜色依旧鲜艳，那张脸仿佛让整个屋子都活了起来。
玛尔塔说，这张照片帮一家人熬过了三个艰难的冬天。
每年春天，她都试着把母亲笔记本上记下的食谱重新做出来。
冷藏间里有猪肉、牛肉和羊肉；每到星期五还有海鲜。
她把肉切成薄片，丢进一锅热腾腾的酱汁里。
旁边再摆上一碗薯条、一份洋葱沙拉和一碟小零食。
客人慢慢咀嚼，最后舔舔手指，再用纸巾擦干净。
他们在长木桌边吃饭；到了夏天，就跑到湖边野餐。
七月的一个下午，她的外孙从岩石上跳进水里。
水又深又凉，有一瞬间他确信自己会淹死。
他咳着水浮了上来，雨也开始往野餐布上倾倒。
那年肉价猛跌，可玛尔塔还是抱怨成本太高。
最让一家人想不通的，是笔记本上的某一页。
谁也没法猜出最后一行写的是什么。
后来一位城里来的年轻厨师做了一次彻底的改动：他把这道菜煮了八个小时。
如今各种族背景的客人都会从城里开车来吃这一口。
